name: antitone_variation325
math: For decreasing weights with a nonnegative final weight, the absolute final weight plus the discrete variation equals the initial weight.

name: antitone_weighted_bound325
math: If all partial sums of z through N have norm at most B, a decreasing weight with nonnegative final value bounds the weighted norm by B times its initial weight.

name: coprime_mobius_log_weight_bound325
math: For N at least one, the absolute sum of restricted mu n divided by n times log of N divided by n from one through N is at most log N. This is a weaker derived envelope than equation 2.10.

name: log_envelope_exceeds_cited_budget325
math: At q = 1 and N = 4, the elementary log N envelope exceeds 1.00303 q over phi q. This compares upper bounds and asserts no failure of the cited estimate.

name: odd_coprime_mobius_bound325
math: The absolute reciprocal Mobius sum through floor x with odd indices coprime to q is at most one.

name: odd_coprime_mobius_log_bound325
math: For N at least one, the odd coprime reciprocal Mobius sum with log of N over the index has absolute value at most log N.

name: reset_strict_interior_counterexample325
math: At x = 2.16e20, take q = 27000000000000, a = 1, delta = -1/10000000 and alpha = 1/54000000000000 minus 1 over twice x times 10000000. MinorHyp and the large denominator condition hold. The reset numerator zero, denominator one and delta = 8000000 minus 1/10000000 are also valid. The reset denominator is strictly below y and absolute delta q is strictly below eight y.
